benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures broad decision quality across applied use-case families and the Boolean/Noul, Choice, and Ordered Score primitives. The dedicated reasoning track is scored separately.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Agent Control, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures whether a model can retain useful agent context, route tool calls and skills, verify runtime outcomes, and gate or rank actions by safety and impact.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Browser Automation, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures whether a model can select the right browser action and target from a runtime-defined set of possible interactions.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Code Search, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures semantic code retrieval: matching a query to the right code line and ranking the most useful codebase results first.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Coding Agents, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures whether a coding agent is ready to complete a task and which intermediate context or results it should retain while working.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Databases, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures whether a model can classify a database row into the correct record category or workflow.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Ecommerce, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures product and query relevance: whether a model can select and prioritize the items that best satisfy a shopper's request.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Evidence Reasoning, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures whether a model can select the evidence that supports or verifies a claim instead of relying on superficial text matching.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Finance, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures financial decision quality, including selecting an appropriate trading action and scoring choices against quantitative evidence.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Financial, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures financial-intent routing: sending a request to the correct financial workflow or service.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Games, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures tactical game decisions: choosing goals, commands, and controls that fit the current game state.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(General Assistant, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures whether a general assistant can route a user's request to the right capability, workflow, or next action.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Home Automation, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures alert triage and action selection for connected-home events: deciding which alert matters and what the automation should do next.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Knowledge Graphs, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures graph navigation and relation selection: choosing the edge or relation that best connects an entity to the requested target.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Legal, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures document-workflow decisions in legal settings: selecting the appropriate action or disposition for a legal document and case.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Logic, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures multi-step logical inference: selecting the conclusion supported by a set of structured statements and constraints.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Multi Hop Search, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures multi-hop evidence reasoning: deciding whether the evidence is sufficient and selecting the answer that follows across linked facts.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Online Safety, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures safety classification and severity scoring: detecting harmful content and judging how serious the risk is.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Privacy, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures bounded extraction under privacy constraints: selecting the requested value without leaking or confusing sensitive fields.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Public Sector, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures entity alignment in public-sector records: linking a mention or record to the correct canonical entity.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Robotics, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures embodied action selection: choosing the robot skill or tactical action that best fits the current state and objective.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Search, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures search-plan routing: selecting the retrieval or search strategy that best matches the user's information need.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Social Media, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures content classification and filtering for social posts: selecting the posts that match a policy, topic, or relevance criterion.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Software Agents, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures function and skill routing for software agents: selecting the tool or agent capability that should handle a request.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Software Engineering, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures code-review decision quality: estimating the risk or priority of a proposed code change.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Tax Documents, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures document-page classification: identifying the section or page type represented by a tax document page.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Technical, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures technical document classification: assigning a patent or technical record to the correct section or category.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Web, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures web retrieval verification: judging whether a retrieved page or passage is relevant to the query.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Web Content, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures web-content filtering: detecting whether page structure contains advertising or other unwanted content.

benchmarks.name: DecisionBench(Reasoning, eng, v1)
benchmarks.description: Measures multi-step evidence reasoning across Boolean/Noul, Choice, and Ordered Score outputs. Unsupported and error rows count as misses.
